description: This file defines the RPC API for PyTorch's distributed module, including functions for remote procedure calls, synchronization, shutdown, and RRef management, with detailed profiling and error handling.

classes.name: AllGatherStates
classes.description: Class managing the state for the all-gather operation in distributed RPC, including gathered objects and synchronization signal.

classes.name: RRef
classes.description: Class representing a Remote Reference (RRef) in PyTorch distributed RPC, with methods for remote object management and type introspection.

methods.name: _use_rpc_pickler
methods.description: Context manager to override the default RPC pickler temporarily.

methods.name: _require_initialized
methods.description: Decorator to ensure RPC is initialized before executing the function.

methods.name: method_factory
methods.description: Creates methods for RRef class with proper docstrings and delegation.

methods.name: remote
methods.description: Initiates a remote procedure call to run a function on another worker and returns an RRef.

methods.name: rpc_sync
methods.description: Performs a blocking RPC call to execute a function on another worker.

methods.name: rpc_async
methods.description: Performs a non-blocking RPC call to execute a function on another worker, returning a Future.

methods.name: get_worker_info
methods.description: Retrieves WorkerInfo for a given worker name or current worker if None.

methods.name: _to_worker_info
methods.description: Converts a worker identifier (name, rank, WorkerInfo) to WorkerInfo object.

methods.name: _rref_typeof_on_owner
methods.description: Returns the type of the object referenced by an RRef, optionally blocking.

methods.name: _rref_typeof_on_user
methods.description: Gets the type of an RRef's object asynchronously or synchronously.

methods.name: _wait_all
methods.description: Context manager that waits for all futures returned by rpc_async to complete.

methods.name: _all_gather
methods.description: Collects data from all workers using RPC, with leader election and broadcasting results.

methods.name: _barrier
methods.description: Synchronizes local and remote RPC processes.

methods.name: _wait_all_workers
methods.description: Blocks until all RPC workers reach this point, used for graceful shutdown.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the RPC framework, optionally gracefully waiting for all processes.

methods.name: _finalize_shutdown
methods.description: Performs cleanup and shutdown of RPC agent and RRef context.

methods.name: get_worker_info
methods.description: Returns WorkerInfo object for a specified worker or current worker.
